= pdf-glyphs(1)
:doctype: manpage
:manmanual: PDF glyph checks
:mansource: acdc
:revdate: 2026-10-05

== Name
pdf-glyphs - literal punctuation and font coverage

== Description

G01 A`tick`B a´x +`literal`+.

G02 *A`tick`B a´x* _A`tick`B a´x_.

G03 Combining q̀ q́ and precomposed à é stay accented.

G04 Literal ⇒ ⇐ ⇔ → ← ↔.

G11 Replacements => <= -> <-.

G05 Missing 中 日 한.

G06 link:https://example.org[+`label`+ ⇒] footnote:note[+`note`+].

[source,text]
----
G07 A`tick`B a´x q̀ q́ ⇒ ⇐ ⇔
